translations.en: Empowering African students to achieve their dreams through world-class education in India.
Live Your Dream
We connect African students with Indian universities, making sure they obtain quality education and satisfy their quest.
Scollarly is an agency that helps African students fulfill their quest to obtain the highest level of education in recognized Indian universities.

Scollarly started because too many African students were getting exploited by paid agents, or giving up entirely because they didn't know where to begin. We built the free alternative. Our goal is simple: if you want to study in India and you put in the effort, we make sure nothing stops you.
Commitment
We don't just send you a university list and move on. We stay with you until you actually land in India.
Inclusivity
Francophone, Anglophone, East African, West African, every student gets the same full service, no exceptions.
Honesty
We tell you the truth, even when it's not what you want to hear. That's the only kind of advice that actually helps.
Where there's unity, God commands a blessing.
You never pay us, not once

Most local agents charge €200–€1,000 before you've even seen an offer letter. With Scollarly, the university pays us only after you successfully enroll. You hand over no money at any stage, not during, not after.
Your admission will be real

Because we only profit when you actually enroll at a real university, fake or invalid offer letters earn us nothing. We have every financial reason to make sure your admission is genuine and from an accredited institution.
We stay with you until you land
Most agents help with the application and then vanish when visa time comes. We guide you through every step, from choosing your university to the airport pickup in India. One team, the whole journey.
Zero risk on your side
If for any reason things don't work out, you've lost nothing, no money, no time you can't recover. The financial risk sits entirely with us, which is exactly why we work hard to make it work.

The short version: We only make money when you succeed, so misleading you, rushing you into the wrong university, or cutting corners on your visa isn't just bad service, it costs us directly. Our interests and yours are one and the same.
Consultation & Counseling
We talk with you, via WhatsApp or call, to understand your situation, your results, and which programs actually fit your goals.
University Admissions
We handle the paperwork and talk directly to the university on your behalf. No missed deadlines, no guessing, we know what each school needs.
Scholarships & Financial Aid
Most of our partner universities offer partial scholarships to students we refer. We make sure you get every reduction you qualify for.
Visa Assistance
The visa step trips most students up. We've been through it dozens of times, we tell you exactly what to prepare and what to expect.
Pre-Departure & Post-Arrival Support
We don't disappear once your visa is approved. We help with flight planning, meet you at the airport, and stay in touch while you settle in.
All our services are completely FREE of charge
We assign a dedicated agent to assist you through the entire visa process. All documents are verified before and after application.
Fees shown are estimates for reference. International student fees may differ. Contact Scollarly for your personalised fee breakdown in USD.
